scope: Mock answer-review resume preflight currentness at API admission and worker dispatch

defect.observation: A cached approved-answer review was admitted after actual document regeneration left its preflight stale, despite unchanged profile, question, form fingerprint and preflight event.

verification.environment: Windows Python3.12; temporary SQLite database and loopback mock HTTP; no browser or external provider
coverage: Real document regeneration invalidates cached review before operation or request-audit admission
Current refreshed preflight permits the same approved answer again
Legacy queued resume with current operation snapshot and stale original review blocks before adapter access
Successful current review and immutable completed receipt replay
Existing wrong-profile, wrong-question, changed-answer, changed-form and missing-result refusals

independent_review.binding: Exact production and regression Git blobs listed above
limitations: Review is separate from parent-executed runtime verification
No claim of a new transaction-atomicity guarantee

known_limits: Focused verification uses an isolated SQLite database and loopback fixture HTTP. PostgreSQL and full connected journey proof remain separate.
This is a MOCK/FIXTURE non-submitting path. External application submission stays OFF.
The full MJ-REQ-292 requirement and its formal 60-step ledger are not accepted by this contribution.
Base main has separately owned cancellation timing and public-worker deadline test failures; this change does not resolve or waive them.
